messages:
maria: Quick async check — kernel/continuous-batching/KV sprint status. TL;DR: 2 blockers holding milestone v1.2. Blockers: 1) kv-eviction heuristic (PR #472) causing cold-stall on canary; 2) continuous-batching handshake misses on long seq (>2048) under load. Owners listed below, need ETA and review pings.

alex: On PR #472, I pushed an update last night to change threshold from 0.2->0.35. Still seeing evictions in canary-metrics. Adding logs now.

alex: log snippet:
```
if (cache.usage_ratio() > 0.35) evict_batch();
```

jamal: I can take the KV eviction follow-up today. Will run local repro with seq=4096. ETA EOD.

tess: Continuous-batching handshake: I reproduced the missing prefix KV on cpu-sim with microbatch=8. I think kernel handshake isn't honoring seq offset when partial-prefetch=true. Sending PR now.

maria: Thanks — can you @sam for kernel review when PR ready? it's blocking canary.

sam: pinged. I have a slot after 11:30 PST. Will do quick pass, prioritize correctness over perf changes.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for branch: refs/heads/perf-kv-evict (canary window 15m) — monitoring metrics channel.

maya: Ops note — if canary shows >10% tail-latency regression we stop and revert. Current capacity for canary nodes is limited; if we need scale we need tickets to infra.

jamal: quick updates — local repro shows stall at step 132 for seq=4096, going to capture heap and KV metrics.

tess: PR #479 posted: 'kernel: preserve seq_offset in handshake when partial-prefetch'. small, adds test

sam: reviewing #479 now. left 2 nits. nothing blocking merge. once merged we should run an instrumented canary

alex: after merging #472 and #479, need to coordinate canary order. propose: merge #479 -> instrumented canary -> merge #472 -> full canary. Thoughts?

maria: sounds good. @deploy-bot can you schedule instrumented canary after #479 merges? also add tracing flag: runtime.handshake.trace=true

deploy-bot: scheduled instrumented canary for refs/heads/kernel-handshake (#479) — window 20m starting ~8345010200

maya: assigned infra ticket INF-128 for temporary canary capacity. ETA 2h.

jamal: captured heap+kv profile attached (link) — shows large KV churn right before stall.

tess: thanks — will add a guard to avoid aggressive prefetch eviction during handshake

sam: merged #479. starting instrumented canary run. monitoring logs.

maria: timeline: jamal to validate repro & provide profile (in-progress), sam to watch canary (in-progress), maya to prep infra (in-progress), alex to prepare merge sequence. Expected next sync: closure or rollback within 3h.

alex: PR #472 waiting for logs from jamal; if jamal confirms threshold tweak helps we can merge after smoke tests.

jamal: confirmed: threshold tweak reduces churn; will run 1000-req soak and share numbers by 2h.

maria: thanks team. quick asks: - comment ownership on PRs, - if anyone blocks, drop 'blocked' reaction, - update the milestone ticket M-142 with PR links and canary timestamps.

sam: added review approvals, left small docs nit.

tess: added ownership comments.

maya: INF-128 done, canary capacity added.

deploy-bot: instrumented canary complete — no regression observed, handshake traces show seq_offset preserved. Starting full canary for perf-kv-evict.

alex: merging #472 now, will monitor.

deploy-bot: full canary started for refs/heads/perf-kv-evict — 15m window

maria: if full canary stays green we'll close M-142 and cut patch for v1.2

jamal: soak results: 0.8% tail-latency uplift, acceptable, no stalls in 1k runs.

tess: rolling post-merge cleanup tasks: add unit test for sequence window, add a metric kv.prefetch.evictions.

maria: awesome — final checklist: 1) close PRs, 2) update M-142 changelog, 3) schedule postmortem if regression during rollout. I'll follow up in the milestone ticket. thanks all :tada:

sam: thx

alex: thx all

jamal: will open a follow-up for heuristic tuning

maria: thread end — marking as async summary.
